blocks.text: A long contract, report or manual? AI reads it in seconds and pulls out what you need.

items: What matters most for you (deadlines, prices, obligations).
Complicated parts explained in plain language.
Questions you should ask before signing.

blocks.text: I'll paste the terms of my internet contract. Write: 1) a 5-point summary, 2) all deadlines and costs, 3) what to watch out for. [paste text]
You can paste the text or attach a file (PDF, Word) with the attachment button, if the tool supports it. For very long documents, ask it to work part by part.
For contracts, loans and the law, AI helps you understand – before signing, ask an expert. And don't upload documents with other people's personal data without permission.
Claude can work with very long documents at once – it's great for summaries and comparing documents.
In ChatGPT you can add several files and ask questions about them.
Gemini can also work with files from your Google Drive, if you allow it.
